task_completion.description: The agent opens the Bologna Pasubio SUMO scenario files from the correct directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the agent navigating to or opening files in /home/ga/SUMO_Scenarios/bologna_pasubio/ within a text editor or SUMO-netedit.

task_completion.description: At least 4 new bus stops are defined on edges that previously lacked them.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code or GUI view showing the definition of at least 4 new <busStop> elements with unique IDs/lanes.

task_completion.description: A new bus line 'Line_Express_N' is configured with at least 3 vehicles and a 600s headway.
task_completion.visual_evidence: XML configuration or route file showing 'Line_Express_N' with 3 <vehicle> or <flow> entries having depart times spaced by ~600 seconds.

task_completion.description: At least 50 person trips are generated with mode='public'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A trip file or script showing at least 50 <person> elements with <walk> or <ride> tags specifying lines or public transit modes.

task_completion.description: The SUMO simulation is executed to process the new transit configuration.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The SUMO-GUI or command line showing the simulation running, often with a progress bar or vehicles moving on the map.

task_completion.description: The service coverage report is generated at the specified path with correct columns.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer or text editor showing /home/ga/SUMO_Output/transit_service_report.csv with columns: stop_id, stop_name_or_lane, is_new, line_served, boarding_count, alighting_count.

task_completion.description: A summary text file is created explaining the changes and impact.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor showing the content of /home/ga/SUMO_Output/transit_redesign_summary.txt mentioning 'Line_Express_N' and ridership impact.

integrity.description: The agent manually edited or scripted the XML/config files rather than just creating the final report.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots of a text editor (like VS Code or Vim) or Netedit showing the actual modification of .nod.xml, .edg.xml, or .rou.xml files.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the SUMO suite (GUI or CLI) to generate results.
integrity.visual_evidence: Visuals of the SUMO-GUI interface or terminal output showing simulation steps being processed.

integrity.description: The CSV report contains actual data (boarding/alighting counts) rather than just headers or zeros.
integrity.visual_evidence: The content of transit_service_report.csv showing non-zero integers in the boarding/alighting columns.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires specific file paths: Scenario in /home/ga/SUMO_Scenarios/bologna_pasubio/, CSV output in /home/ga/SUMO_Output/transit_service_report.csv, and summary in /home/ga/SUMO_Output/transit_redesign_summary.txt. Key constraints: Line name must be 'Line_Express_N', exactly 4+ new stops, 3+ vehicles, ~600s headway, and 50+ person trips using mode='public'.
